description: Use this when the user shares the stocks or funds they own (a portfolio, holdings, 'my stocks', a broker list) and wants to know how it looks, a score, or what to watch. Takes up to 60 holdings, each a ticker or company name with optional shares or money amount. Returns invest-like's portfolio score from 0 to 100 (quality, value, growth, safety, spread), a plain read of the whole portfolio, its weights, how its P/E, margin, growth and dividend compare with the 500 largest US companies, one strength and one thing to watch. ETFs such as VOO or VWCE are supported. No login or personal data needed.

currency.description: Currency of the amounts and the report (default USD)

halal.description: true when the user cares whether the holdings are halal

amount.description: Money in this holding, in the portfolio currency, if the user gave it

shares.description: Number of shares, if the user gave it

name: score_portfolio
title: Score a portfolio
